wiki_text: Sinopec's Longkou (Yantai Longkou) LNG terminal Phase 1 (6.5 mtpa; 266,000 m3 berth; 4x220,000 m3 tanks) reportedly completed construction around March 2025 and entered the testing/commissioning stage by January 2026, ahead of commercial operation. Sinopec's August 2025 semi-annual report still listed the project as under construction.

PipeChina's Longkou Nanshan LNG terminal (first PipeChina terminal to enter construction; 3 phases, ~20 mtpa total, ~35 billion yuan) reportedly completed Phase 1 construction around March 2025, began offering presale import slots from July 2025, and entered the testing stage by January 2026 in preparation for official operation.
